open_points.text: load_configuration: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST check the settings load_runtime_settings answers in this order and answer a StartDiagnostic at the first check that fails, naming the failed check and the failed item by its RuntimeSettings field name, the equal-secrets check both items of the first equal pair in that order, the check that the two ports differ the service_listen item alone, and never a value, items within one check taken in the order of the imported RUNTIME_SETTING_ORDER constant: the items the imported RUNTIME_SETTINGS_ALL_OR_NONE constant names all set or all unset, a partial set failing on its first unset item; each item the imported RUNTIME_SETTINGS_REQUIRED constant names set; each address well formed; the two addresses' ports different; each secret at least the imported SECRET_MIN_BYTES constant in bytes of its text encoded by the imported TEXT_ENCODING constant, a secret whose text cannot be so encoded failing that check for its item, so that no setting makes the check raise; no two secrets equal; the store and the backup location apart.
open_points.other_text:
Reflective attribute access is rejected: never call getattr, hasattr,
  setattr, delattr, or vars; every declared field and operation is
  addressed directly by name, including in try/finally cleanup.
open_points.question: The three imported constants identify RuntimeSettings fields only as runtime strings, while the gate requires every field to be addressed directly and forbids reflective lookup; either replace the string-name constants with a typed/direct access surface, expose their field mapping in the prompt, or permit the required reflective access.
